description: Requests Lightbringer patent preparation for an already registered innovation, expressing the user’s decision to pursue patent filing. Advances the innovation description into the Lightbringer team’s workflow and triggers email notifications to the assigned specialist and inventor. Returns whether preparation was newly requested or had already been requested. Email delivery status is not included. Separate from registration; does not itself complete preparation, file a patent or pay for services.
name: request_patent_preparation

outcome.description: Whether patent preparation was newly requested or was already requested; neither confirms completion or filing

title: Request patent preparation
